title: Blowerall
category: Brand identity • Print design • Social media design
description: Blowerall brings ventilation products and installation services into one visual system. The designs cover the logo, business cards, warranty sheet and Arabic social campaigns.
challenge: Use the same identity across small printed documents and image-led service campaigns.
solution: A red-and-yellow mark and curved graphic elements connect product imagery, benefit-led headlines and contact details.
results: A coordinated set of identity, print and campaign applications.
